column1: The Key Audit Matter,How The Matter Was Addressed In Our Audit

The company has a complex IT environment with a
number of independent stand-alone systems most of
which are relied on to provide information for financial
reporting and routine decision-making.
The systems depend on manual intervention to transfer
data from one system to another, and therefore there is
significant reliance on manual reconciliation of information
for purposes of financial reporting.
Many of the company’s internal controls over financial
reporting are dependent upon automated application
controls, completeness, and integrity of reports generated
by the IT-systems.
Given the high dependency on technology and the manual
intervention to transfer data, we considered this to be a
key audit matter for our audit.,"We evaluated the IT environment and relevant applications
